records.Subject: service due message on TAC-C-0150 display
records.Description: Service interval reminder on the 0150 display. PM to be booked.

records.Subject: PM 4000h TAC-C-0142
records.Resolution__c: 4,000 h PM. Oil, oil filter, air filter. Controller log shows 3 E-14 auto-restart events since July (07/28, 08/30, 09/17), no callouts. Recommend firmware 5.1 update; still not done.

records.CommentBody: 3x e-14 auto restart in ctrl log since july, customer didnt notice. fw 5.1 still not done, need a 2h window from dave. raising separate wo?

records.Subject: FRS-P-0031 casing joint follow up
records.Description: 3 month check of casing joint after the June casing replacement (00041988).
records.Resolution__c: Joint dry, no residue. Closing.

records.Subject: strainer basket torn 0044
records.Description: Strainer basket mesh torn, found at strainer round.
records.Resolution__c: Replaced basket 18-1120 and cover gasket 18-1121.

records.Subject: HCP-200 wear ring replacement FRS-P-0007
records.Description: Follow-up to 00043360. Fit new wear rings on the pit pump. Rings on order from Halden, ETA mid October.

records.CommentBody: Halden quoted 4-5 weeks. Pump stays in service meanwhile, customer aware flow is down.

records.Subject: HCP-200 pit pump low flow
records.Description: Customer reports the pit pump FRS-P-0007 is about 20% down on flow. No alarms.
records.Resolution__c: Clearance measured 0.71 mm, over the limit in the old scanned manual. Wear rings ordered. Follow-up case for fitting.

records.CommentBody: FYI for whoever does the follow-up: the clearance limit for the HCP-200 is only in the scanned paper manual (the 1998 Halden one in the manual library), it's not in MaintPro or on the wiki.

records.Subject: Pit pump flow
records.TextBody:
Hi team,

Our flow meter on the pit return shows about 20% less than in the spring with the same level. No alarms. Can Maria take a look when she's here?

Gary Pham
Maintenance Planner, Sierra Springs Beverage - Fresno

records.Subject: BX-20 drive coupling worn
records.Description: Found drive coupling insert worn on line 4 BX-20 during PM.
records.Resolution__c: Replaced 77-0500.

records.Subject: P-07 cavitation FRS-P-0033
records.Description: P-07 cavitation alarm, operators report gravel noise from the HCP-500.
records.Resolution__c: Strainer dP read 0.42 bar, cleaned strainer. Suction valve found three-quarters open, opened fully. P-07 cleared, no noise after 30 min.

records.CommentBody: No P-07 overnight. Suction valve handwheel tagged so nobody throttles it again.

records.Subject: E-11 delivery pressure high 0143
records.Description: 0143 tripped E-11 at 11:40.
records.Resolution__c: Customer's contractor closed the main header valve to tie in a new drop. Valve opened, unit reset. Asked Dave to warn us next time.

records.Subject: Oil change FRS-C-0101
records.Description: Scheduled oil change, 4,000 h since last change.
records.Resolution__c: Oil changed (SynLube 46), oil filter, air filter. Separator dP 0.41 bar.

records.Subject: repeat E-14 on 0142
records.Description: Repeat E-14 on 0142. Unit tripped 07/01 afternoon, cooler fins cleaned on the exhaust side and restarted. Tripped again around 01:30 on 07/02. Ambient at the unit 38 C. Dave Ortiz called at 06:00.
records.Resolution__c: Controller TS-2 113 C vs handheld 102 C at the discharge flange, 11 C high. TS-2 replaced again (41-2207, from Daniel's van). Controller and handheld within 4 C after the swap. Firmware is 5.0. Update not done, no X10 cable available. Firmware update to be scheduled.

records.CommentBody: On site. TS-2 controller 113 C, handheld 102 C. Same as March?

Second TS-2 on this unit since March. Check SB-2026-003 before you close this: on firmware below 5.1 a failing TS-2 is reported as E-14, so these may never have been real high temps. 0142 is still on 5.0 and needs the 5.1 update.
TS-2 swapped, unit running, within 4 C.
No trips since 07/02. Closing. Firmware update open, Dave can't give us a window this week (big inbound).

records.Subject: RE: 0142
records.TextBody:
Priya,

No trips since Thursday. When do you want to do the software update? This week is bad, we have the big inbound. Week of the 20th should work.

Dave

records.Subject: TAC-P-0045 seal weep
records.Description: Slight weep at seal faces on 0045, under the P-04 trigger. Seal kit ordered.

records.CommentBody: 18-0356 on order. weep is maybe 1 drop/min, ok to run till it comes.
Kit is in Tacoma stock. Do it at the next PM, not as a separate trip.

records.Subject: FRS-P-0031 casing joint weeping after seal change
records.Description: Casing joint weeping after the seal change on 06/02. Casing bolts torqued to 45 N-m per the manual (IOM Rev D 8.4). Joint weeping at about 4 o'clock after 2 h in service, ~5.5 bar discharge. Duty switched to FRS-P-0012.
records.Resolution__c: Gasket seat cracked (dye penetrant, two bolt holes). Serial HCP350-241187 is in the Halden SB-2025-009 range (revised casing from HCP350-240001). New casing half fitted with new gasket, torqued to 38 N-m cross pattern, two passes, per SB-2025-009. 24 h run, dry.
records.Parts_Used__c: 18-0356 x1 (seal, 06/02); casing half + gasket (Halden, no charge)

records.CommentBody: emailed Stefan Wirth at Halden w/ photos. not going above 45.
dye pen shows cracks at 2 bolt holes. casing ordered from Halden.
Halden says this serial is in SB-2025-009, revised casing, 38 N-m not 45. Manual Rev D still says 45. I've asked Stefan why the manual was never updated.
casing fitted 6/11, 24h run dry. closing

records.Subject: Chiller flow fault
records.Description: L-06 chilled water flow fault, chiller off.
records.Resolution__c: Customer's chilled water strainer blocked (their side). Customer cleaned it, flow restored, chiller reset and running. LWT 7.1 C.

records.Subject: BX-12 tracking left after belt change - line 2
records.Description: Belt replaced 05/06 on line 2 case conveyor (FRS-V-0201). Since restart the belt tracks to the left (motor side) and rubs the side guide at the tail end. C-02 stops: 7 on 2nd shift 05/07. Take-up adjusted several times, it keeps coming back.
records.Resolution__c: Belton confirmed a known issue, see email thread. Fix applied, tracking OK.

records.CommentBody: emailed Belton (Henrik Sauer) with details, waiting.
Pulled the guard with Olu, photos sent to Belton. Line 2 running slow over the weekend with an operator watching.
Belton replied, known issue on this model. Part on order, interim fix done this morning.
new idler fitted, tracking ok after 2h at full speed. closing

records.Subject: Guard interlock nuisance trips
records.Description: C-06 safety relay fault with the guard closed, 3-4 times a day.
records.Resolution__c: Guard switch actuator bent, realigned and tightened. Tested 20 open/close cycles.

records.Subject: suction pressure low P-01
records.Description: P-01 on 0012 while running as duty during customer CIP.
records.Resolution__c: Customer side. Supply tank level transmitter reading high, tank actually low. Customer instrument tech recalibrated it. Nothing wrong on the pump.

records.Subject: E-14 high discharge temp TAC-C-0142
records.Description: Compressor 0142 shut down overnight on E-14 high discharge temperature. Customer restarted it at 06:30, running, wants it checked.
records.Resolution__c: E-14 overnight. Controller TS-2 112 C vs handheld 96 C at the discharge flange. Replaced TS-2 (41-2207). Readings within 3 C after the swap.

records.CommentBody: ts-2 reading 16c high vs handheld. sensor swapped, unit running.
no trips overnight, closing

records.Subject: comp 0142 tripped overnight
records.TextBody:
Morning,

0142 shut down sometime after 2am with E-14 high discharge temp. Night shift didn't call it in. I restarted it at 6:30 and it's running but I'd like someone to look at it today. It's not hot in there, 9 degrees outside.

Dave Ortiz
Maintenance Manager | Puget Cold Chain | Tacoma

records.Subject: VRS-45 coupling inspection per Vastra
records.Description: Check coupling element at next service per Vastra.
records.Resolution__c: Coupling element inspected through window, no cracks, no rubber dust. Compressor room ventilation ok.

records.Subject: Line 1 belt tracking right
records.Description: Line 1 belt drifting right after customer washdown, C-02 twice.
records.Resolution__c: Washdown hose had knocked the tail take-up. Adjusted take-up half a turn, tracking centred. No belt change on this unit.

records.Subject: TAC-P-0044 vibration high
records.Description: P-03 on 0044 overnight. NDE overall 7.6 mm/s at panel.
records.Resolution__c: Two foundation bolts loose on the NDE side. Re-torqued all foundation bolts, alignment re-checked (ok). NDE 2.1 mm/s after.

records.Subject: oil level low fresno comp
records.Resolution__c: fixed

records.Subject: noisy on start
records.Description: Customer says compressor 0150 makes a rattling noise when it starts.
records.Resolution__c: ok now

records.Subject: TAC-C-0143 down on E-31
records.Description: Dave Ortiz called the on-call line at 05:02. Compressor 0143 down on E-31 since about 04:10, site had a power dip at that time (lights flickered in dock 3). 0142 restarted on its own. Customer running on 0142 only.
records.Resolution__c: E-31 after a grid dip at 04:10. Reset by Daniel Reyes per HV-PROC-07. Insulation 2.4 GOhm. Back in service 07:55, no repeat during the morning. Customer confirmed the dip with their utility.

records.CommentBody: reset done per hv-proc-07, 0143 back on line 07:55. insulation 2.4 gohm.
Thanks Daniel. Closing. Dave asked if we can give them a list of what to record before we arrive next time, I'll send him one.

records.Subject: RE: 0143 E-31
records.TextBody:
Daniel, thanks for getting here so fast. Utility confirmed a voltage sag at 04:09 on our feeder. Both units running now.

Dave

records.Subject: Air filter alarm TAC-C-0143
records.Description: E-18 air filter differential pressure on 0143.
records.Resolution__c: Air filter element replaced (41-1512). Old one was full of frost dust from the dock door.

records.Subject: BX-20 install support line 4
records.Description: New BX-20 on line 4. Corvane to support Belton install and take over PM from commissioning.
records.Resolution__c: Commissioned with Belton FAE remote. Tracking and tension set, PE sensors aligned, PM plan created in MaintPro.

records.CommentBody: PM every 6 wks same as the 12s. Belton manual for the 20 is on order, we only have the BX-12 one.

records.Subject: belt splice lifting line 2
records.Description: Splice on line 2 belt lifting at one edge, catching on the scraper.
records.Resolution__c: Re-spliced with hot splice kit. Scraper reset.

records.Subject: TAC-P-0044 P-07 cavitation
records.Description: Dave reports noise from 0044 and P-07 on the panel.
records.Resolution__c: Strainer packed with cardboard fibre from their glycol tank lid that fell in. Strainer dP 0.55 bar before cleaning. Cleaned, P-07 cleared. Customer fishing the rest out of the tank.

records.Subject: P-08 sensor fault new HCP-500
records.Description: Intermittent P-08 on the new HCP-500, about once a day since startup.
records.Resolution__c: Moisture in PT-2 connector, gland not tightened at install. Dried, resealed, replaced PT-2 as a precaution (19-0301).

records.Subject: E-14 high discharge temp FRS-C-0101
records.Description: Compressor tripped E-14 twice today. Outside temp 41 C, compressor room hot.
records.Resolution__c: Real over-temperature. Cooler fins clogged, cleaned. Room at 44 C, room exhaust fan not running (customer's fan, breaker tripped). Customer reset fan breaker. TS-2 matched handheld within 2 C. Ran 2 h loaded, discharge 92 C.

records.CommentBody: NO TRIPS OVERNIGHT. CUSTOMER TO PUT FAN ON THEIR PM LIST.

records.Subject: TAC-V-0210 belt slipping on start
records.Resolution__c: Drive coupling insert cracked, replaced 77-0500. Belt slip on start was the coupling, tension was fine.

records.Subject: FRS-P-0012 seal leak
records.Description: Found seal leaking on standby pump 0012 during strainer round. Leak sensor wet.
records.Resolution__c: Mechanical seal replaced with 18-0355. Ran 1 h, dry.

records.Subject: oil in air downstream of 0142
records.Description: Dave reports oil in the air line after the dryer on compressor 0142, noticed at a drop in the packing area.
records.Resolution__c: Separator element replaced (41-3075), scavenge line orifice cleaned. Checked again after 2 days, dry.

records.Subject: oil in air line comp 0142
records.TextBody:
Hi,

We're getting oil at the drop by packing (after the dryer). Looks like it's coming from 0142, 0143 side is dry.
Can someone come out this week?

Thanks
Dave Ortiz
Maintenance Manager | Puget Cold Chain | Tacoma

records.Subject: NK-300 high pressure trips
records.Description: Chiller tripping L-01 in the afternoons. Customer says it started this week.
records.Resolution__c: Condenser coils packed with cottonwood seed. Washed both coils from inside out. Head pressure back to normal. Recommended a coil screen before next spring.

records.CommentBody: Quoted coil screens to the customer, they will think about it.

records.Subject: line 1 conveyor stopping C-05
records.Description: Customer reports BX-12 on line 1 stopping on C-05 product jam several times per shift.
records.Resolution__c: Carton jams at the transfer plate, plate bent upward about 4 mm. Straightened and re-set the gap. No C-04 since.

records.Subject: TAC-C-0150 startup punch list
records.Description: New VRS-75 commissioned 02/17. Punch list: condensate drain line not sloped, missing label on isolator, customer wants remote run signal to BMS.
records.Resolution__c: Drain line re-sloped by customer contractor, labels fitted, BMS run signal wired to dry contact by customer electrician. Signed off with Dave Ortiz.

records.Subject: TAC-P-0045 bearing temp alarm
records.Description: P-02 on standby pump 0045 after it was swapped to duty for the 0044 PM.
records.Resolution__c: Over-greased at last PM. Opened relief plug and ran 30 min, DE bearing down from 88 C to 61 C. Reminded team about the relief plug.

records.CommentBody: Second time this year on 0045. Whoever greases it, open the relief plug and leave it open 5 min.

records.Subject: Compressor not loading - Fresno
records.Description: Plant air at 5.2 bar and dropping, compressor running but won't load. Customer has backup diesel rental on standby.
records.Resolution__c: Inlet valve solenoid coil open circuit. Replaced coil (local purchase, 24 VDC). Loads normally.
